<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 400" width="1000" height="400" role="img" aria-label="Manoj Kumar Sahoo, Junior DevOps and Multi-Cloud Engineer.   <defs>

      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#0d1426"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#1a1442"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="name" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">

      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#a5b4fc"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#f0abfc"/>

    <style>
      .mono { font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, monospace; }
      .sans { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }
      .tile { fill: #ffffff; fill-opacity: 0.045; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-opacity: 0.12; }
      .blink { animation: blink 1.1s steps(2, start) infinite; }
      @keyframes blink { to { visibility: hidden; } }
      .pulse { animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
      @keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.3; } }
      .cell { animation: glow 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
      @keyframes glow { 0%,100% { fill-opacity: 0.05; } 50% { fill-opacity: 0.14; } }
    </style>
  </defs>
